source.description: USBLC6-2SC6 has reciprocal internal IO1 transfer between pins 1 and 6 and IO2 transfer between pins 3 and 4. These manufacturer-described package R/L paths are not PCB copper or zero electrical delay. All unique physical pins, VBUS and GND remain represented.

pcbEtchPolicy: Measure all six copper nets; compose channel paths through the explicit resistor and protection transfers without adding imaginary PCB segments. Internal electrical delay and skew are not assessed.
